import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXNODES = 5000010;
    static final int INF_VAL = 1000000000;
    static int n, m, k, v1, v2, s, t;
    static int[] dist_arr = new int[MAXNODES];
    static boolean[] visited_arr = new boolean[MAXNODES];
    static ArrayList<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head_array = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] next_array = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] to_array = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] v_array = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] cost_array = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int edge_idx = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, v, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int v, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.v = v;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static void insert_edge(int from, int to, int val, int cost) {
        edges.add(new Edge(to, head_array[from], val, cost));
        head_array[from] = edge_idx++;
        edges.add(new Edge(from, head_array[to], 0, -cost));
        head_array[to] = edge_idx++;
    }

    static boolean shortest_path() {
        Arrays.fill(dist_arr, 0, t + 1, INF_VAL);
        Arrays.fill(visited_arr, 0, t + 1, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        dist_arr[s] = 0;
        visited_arr[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            visited_arr[x] = false;
            for (int i = head_array[x]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i - 1).next) {
                int y = edges.get(i - 1).to;
                int c = edges.get(i - 1).cost;
                if (dist_arr[y] <= dist_arr[x] + c || edges.get(i - 1).v == 0) continue;
                dist_arr[y] = dist_arr[x] + c;
                if (!visited_arr[y]) {
                    visited_arr[y] = true;
                    q.offer(y);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_arr[t] != INF_VAL;
    }

    static int augment_flow(int x, int limit) {
        if (x == t) return limit;
        visited_arr[x] = true;
        int flow_res = limit;
        for (int i = head_array[x]; i != 0; i = edges.get(i - 1).next) {
            int y = edges.get(i - 1).to;
            int v = edges.get(i - 1).v;
            int c = edges.get(i - 1).cost;
            if (dist_arr[y] != dist_arr[x] + c || v == 0 || visited_arr[y]) continue;
            int flow = augment_flow(y, Math.min(flow_res, v));
            if (flow > 0) {
                flow_res -= flow;
                edges.get(i - 1).v -= flow;
                edges.get(i ^ 1).v += flow;
                if (flow_res == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return limit - flow_res;
    }

    static int min_cost_flow() {
        int total = 0, flow;
        while (shortest_path()) {
            while ((flow = augment_flow(s, INF_VAL)) > 0) {
                total += flow * dist_arr[t];
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = 0;
        t = (n * 110) + 1;

        Arrays.fill(head_array, 0);
        edges.clear();
        edge_idx = 1;

        for (int i = 2; i <= 110; ++i) {
            insert_edge(IDX(1, i), t, INF_VAL, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                insert_edge(IDX(i, j), IDX(i, j + 1), INF_VAL, v1);
            }
        }
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            insert_edge(s, IDX(x, 1), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                insert_edge(IDX(x, j), IDX(y, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
                insert_edge(IDX(y, j), IDX(x, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(min_cost_flow());
    }

    static int IDX(int x, int k) {
        return x + (k - 1) * n;
    }
}
